description: Find a saved .bip file (or the newest .bip in one folder), detect whether it changed, copy it to a collision-safe output path, and optionally return an Agent-visible preview. This is the stable alternative to unsupported persistent GUI control.

camera.description: Optional saved camera name for the embedded preview. Omit to use the scene's active camera.

height.description: Preview height in pixels. Defaults to 540; allowed range is 64 to 1080.

includePreview.description: Whether to render and embed a temporary PNG from the synchronized copy. Defaults to true.

maxTimeSeconds.description: Time-based preview limit in seconds. Replaces the default sample mode and cannot be combined with an explicit samples value; maximum is 60.

outputScenePath.description: Optional destination for the synchronized .bip copy inside KEYSHOT_OUTPUT_DIR. Existing explicit paths are never overwritten; when omitted, a collision-safe name is generated.

previousFingerprint.description: Optional fingerprint returned by an earlier sync. When it still matches, no copy or preview is created.

samples.description: Preview render samples. Defaults to 16 unless maxTimeSeconds is provided; maximum is 64.

sourcePath.description: Absolute path to a saved .bip scene or a directory whose newest .bip scene should be synchronized. Directories are searched only at their top level.

width.description: Preview width in pixels. Defaults to 960; allowed range is 64 to 1920.

name: keyshot_sync_saved_scene

data.description: Operation-specific structured result data, or null when unavailable.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason, or null after success.

errorCode.description: Stable error category for common failures.

keyshotStdoutTail.description: Truncated tail of KeyShot headless output for diagnostics.

ok.description: True when the requested operation completed successfully.

outputFiles.description: Absolute paths of images or scene files created by the operation.

suggestions.description: Actionable recovery steps for the user or agent.

warnings.description: Non-fatal conditions the user or agent should review.

title: Sync the latest saved KeyShot scene
